Not all levels are created equal.

So after losing a few trades, I decided to figure out which levels are good levels to pick from. Just because price flags just below a resistance level then decides to engulf to N with long pole candles, it doesn't mean its a key level or that where price will bounce back to and move further to the engulfing's intended direction.

Hi Project,

After doing some homework on Caps, I have noticed that generally caps (significant) are reactions to Important DPs of the past and hence price pushes itself to such level and then retraces back.

In this case, I have tried to show the cap in question on a weekly chart.

One thing I suggest you must do is 'Zoom out and mark important Daily and weekly levels on the chart' so that you are not lost in LTF picture.

Hope it helps you in some way
